title: Sheep wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wool' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d8e0ea'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <g fill='url(#wool)' stroke='#aab6c8' stroke-width='1'>
    <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='18'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='52' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='11'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='68' r='11'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='12'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='43' y='76' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8a94a6'/>
  <rect x='52' y='76' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8a94a6'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='42' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a5568'/>
  <rect x='51' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a5568'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#f2f5fa' stroke='#aab6c8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='26' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8eef6' transform='rotate(-20 33 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='26' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8eef6' transform='rotate(20 67 26)'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <g fill='#2b2f45' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='1.5'>
    <rect x='36' y='25' width='12' height='9' rx='4'/>
    <rect x='52' y='25' width='12' height='9' rx='4'/>
    <rect x='47' y='27' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <g fill='#7fd8ff' opacity='0.7'>
    <rect x='38' y='27' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='54' y='27' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8eef6'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='38' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#4a5568'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='38' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#4a5568'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 46 54 42' fill='none' stroke='#8a94a6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
